in.rationale: Anil et al. prove verifier-leading Stackelberg equilibria are necessary and sufficient for complete and sound protocols in verifier-leading sequential PVG formulations where the problem instance is revealed after the verifier picks its strategy. text: The authors prove (Theorem 2) that in verifier-leading sequential PVG formulations where the problem instance is revealed after the verifier picks its strategy, reaching a verifier-leading Stackelberg equilibrium is both necessary and sufficient for a desirable (complete and sound) proof-verification protocol; sufficiency follows because otherwise the verifier could do strictly better by switching to the complete and sound verifier, to which the prover would respond with correct proofs.
title: PVG: verifier-leading Stackelberg equilibrium iff complete and sound protocol
